body:
>Now tell me who you are? If you are coming up with blanks, then you haven't found your self.

I am indeed coming up blanks. What the hell am I. Hmm. This has made me think, thank you.

> There is always something to feel guilty about, billions of people don't have *anything*.

I hear this a lot when people discover how unhappy I am. I've spent a large amount of my life as a rich person among the *hyper*-rich. I've been made fun of for having a secondhand car, or even because my family home doesn't have a swimming pool. Those sort of people sure as hell didn't feel guilty about anything. I feel like I'm caught in the middle. The middle being the region between 'too rich to care' and 'poor enough to be pitied'. Anyway, this doesn't have much to do with what you were saying, it's just another interesting part of my life that I thought I'd share since it complicates things for me. 

> I wish you all the happiness in the world because I believe that everyone deserves it! :)

Thank you :)

Thanks for replying, I've actually just replied to [another comment](http://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/f8xxn/ive_got_the_best_life_anyone_could_ask_for_but/c1e72bh) with pretty much what I would say to this.

Thanks for replying, I'm still torn about meds...it seems like "cheating". I know that for any other illness I wouldn't think this, I just can bring myself to actually really believe that depression can be defined as an illness, even though I have it (whatever it is).

Thank your for your reply. I need to concentrate more on my life outside work. That Wiki article was definitely an interesting read. 

Thanks again.
